findings.detail: Signet marigold — hardiness_rating rewritten though the round never seeded it
findings.why: draft-hardiness targets hardiness_rating IS NULL, so it backfilled round 7's 76 plants, never drafted since July 15. Remediation of a genuinely skipped step rather than a stray write, and the reason round-status.ts now exists (§25).
